summary: National Medicines Regulatory Authorities in low-income countries face challenges in streamlining and tracking medicines registration. OpenRIMS helps these authorities ensure they have the most updated medicines available and approved for prescribing and use. The tool benefits these authorities by streamlining routine tasks and improving data management. It is particularly relevant to countries with limited resources and capacity in regulatory affairs. OpenRIMS addresses the health sector, focusing on improving access to medicines and ensuring their safety and efficacy.
